title: 第9章 案情推测第10章 宋明远的猜测
content_zh:
宋明远目光森寒的看向老鸨：“张妈妈，解释解释吧？”
他现在严重怀疑，张妈妈一开始阻挠他们进来，就是为了不让他们发现这起命案。
老鸨看着地板上的尸体，大脑彻底懵了。
怎么又死人了？
她急忙又给跪了下来，失声痛哭道：“大，大人，这，这事儿，我真的不知道啊！
求大人明鉴啊！”
醉仙楼接二连三的发生命案，这生意还怎么做啊？
宋明远走进屋内，来到酒桌旁边的尸体跟前。
张彪蹲在地上，开始检查尸体。
李廷则在屋内四处查看。
姜峰却径直的走到香炉面前，捻起一点香灰，放到鼻子旁边细细闻了一下，而后面露沉思。
趁着张彪检查尸体的时候，宋明远对着老鸨问道：“这死的又是谁？”
老鸨颤巍巍的抬起头，目光胆怯的望了一眼死者的面容，又连忙摇了摇头，道：“大人，这人我不认识，应该是第一次来。”
“张妈妈，看来你是敬酒不吃吃罚酒啊，还不说实话？！”
宋明远忽然大声喝道。
老鸨吓得亡魂皆冒，又继续磕头，额头都给磕破了，鲜血流了出来，哭着哀求道：
“大人，这里的事情，我真的事先都不知道啊。
我，我现在去找人，问问看有没有人知道。”
宋明远深深的看着她，半晌后，摆了摆手：“去吧，今天你们醉仙楼是铁定开不下去了。
所有人，全都给我在楼里候着。”

等老鸨离开后，宋明远转头看向一旁沉默不语的姜峰，问道：“你怎么看？”
你这口头禅是跟狄仁杰学的吗……姜峰心中腹诽，却直接道：“熟人作案。”
“说说看。”
宋明远示意姜峰继续说下去。
这时，张彪已经查验完尸体，起身回复道：
“头儿，死者身上有多处刀伤，有的伤口是多次刺入导致，但他致命伤是在脖子上，被一刀割破，以至大量失血而亡。
死亡时间，不超过一个时辰。”
李廷在一旁补充说道：“本案最大可能是激情杀人，这满地的碎片残渣，并非是武力交手所至，而是双方争吵时，有人将桌上的酒菜扫落地面所造成的，说明他们当时有人的情绪十分激动，死者身上的多处刀伤，也说明是情绪失控后的泄愤之举。
还有……”
他看向那扇打开的窗户，继续道：“如果事先早有预谋，对方不会选择在这种地方杀人，更不会在杀人的时候，故意开窗让人看到。”
“那么，什么样的事情，会使两个本就相识的人，发生了过激杀人的事情呢？要么是自己的婆娘被对方睡了，要么是利益上的争吵，比如分赃不均。”
“头儿，我觉得可以查一下最近有没有发生过什么抢劫案，或者偷窃案。”
张彪似乎有些不服气的问道：“你怎么知道利益上的事，就是因为分赃不均呢？”
他一直不承认自己的智商要低于李廷。
李廷侃侃而谈，道：“如果是正当生意，没必要过激杀人，生意人大都懂得隐忍和克制，就算因为一时的利益问题，也不会到了杀人这种地步，更何况还是在这种地方杀人。”
“只要我们事后逐一排查，迟早能找到这个人，做正经生意的商人，绝对不会如此冲动。”
这时，姜峰走到死者面前蹲了下来，伸手在其后颈的风池穴摸了一下，旋即抽出一根细长的银针！
霎时间，死者的面容彻底发生了改变！
content_en:
Song Mingyuan looked at the Madam with cold eyes: "Mother Zhang, please explain?"
He now seriously suspected that Zhang's mother blocked their entry in the first place just to prevent them from discovering the murder.
The madam looked at the corpse on the floor and was completely confused.
Why did someone die again?
She hurriedly knelt down again and cried bitterly: "Sir, sir, I really don't know about this!
Please give me some advice! "
Murders occur one after another in Zuixian Tower. How can we still do business?
Song Mingyuan walked into the house and came to the body next to the wine table.
Zhang Biao squatted on the ground and began to examine the body.
Li Ting looked around the house.
Jiang Feng walked straight to the incense burner, picked up some ashes, put it next to his nose and smelled it carefully, then looked thoughtful.
While Zhang Biao was inspecting the body, Song Mingyuan asked the madam: "Who is this dead?"
The old bustard raised his head tremblingly, glanced timidly at the face of the deceased, then quickly shook his head and said: "Sir, I don't know this person. It must be his first time here."
"Mother Zhang, it seems that you are toasting instead of eating and being fined with wine. Why don't you tell the truth?!"
Song Mingyuan suddenly shouted loudly.
The old bustard was so frightened that he lost his soul, and continued to kowtow. His forehead was bruised and blood flowed out. He cried and begged:
"Sir, I really don't know anything about what's going on here in advance.
I, I will go find someone now and ask if anyone knows. "
Song Mingyuan looked at her deeply, and after a while, he waved his hand: "Go, your Zuixian Tower will definitely not be able to open today.
Everyone is waiting for me in the building. "
After the madam left, Song Mingyuan turned to look at Jiang Feng, who was silent at the side, and asked, "What do you think?"
Did you learn this catchphrase from Di Renjie... Jiang Feng cursed in his heart, but said directly: "An acquaintance commits a crime."
"Tell me about it."
Song Mingyuan motioned to Jiang Feng to continue.
At this time, Zhang Biao had already finished examining the body, stood up and replied:
“Boss, the deceased had multiple stab wounds on his body, some of which were caused by multiple stabbings, but his fatal wound was on his neck, which was cut by a single knife, causing him to lose a lot of blood and die.
The time of death is no more than one hour. "
Li Ting added on the side: "This case is most likely a murder of passion. The debris on the ground was not caused by a confrontation with force, but was caused by someone sweeping the food and wine on the table to the ground when the two parties were arguing. This shows that some of them were very excited at the time. The multiple stab wounds on the body of the deceased also indicate that they were venting their anger after losing control of their emotions.
And…”
He looked at the open window and continued: "If it had been planned in advance, the other party would not choose to kill in a place like this, let alone deliberately open the window when killing people."
"So, what kind of thing would cause two people who already knew each other to commit excessive murder? Either their mother-in-law was slept with by the other party, or there was a quarrel over interests, such as uneven sharing of the spoils."
"Boss, I think we can check if there have been any robberies or thefts recently."
Zhang Biao seemed a little unconvinced and asked: "How do you know that the benefits are just because the spoils are unevenly divided?"
He has never admitted that his IQ is lower than Li Ting.
Li Tingkan talked eloquently and said: "If it is a legitimate business, there is no need to kill people excessively. Most businessmen know how to be patient and restrained. Even if it is due to temporary interests, they will not go to the point of killing people, let alone killing people in such a place."
"As long as we investigate one by one afterwards, we will find this person sooner or later. Businessmen who do serious business will never be so impulsive."
At this time, Jiang Feng walked to the deceased and squatted down. He reached out and touched the Fengchi point on the back of his neck, and immediately pulled out a slender silver needle!
In an instant, the face of the deceased completely changed!
